OARP_RANK0_FULLTOUR_SCENE.meaning: rank minimisation over the current Q with no change budget; every rank enters one full GTSP with both directions

OARP_REPLAN2_NATIVE_SCENE.meaning: model 2 against native remaining fragments; unchanged fragments keep their exact internal old connector

task.deferred: D = (P-C) - F, kept and never completed

timing.covered: input checks, normalisation, geometry, fallback, rank construction/solve, GTSP matrix and search, expansion, pre-return audit
timing.ledger: start/end writes and fsync are outside the measured algorithm time and are reported separately

candidate_boundary: generated -> audited -> accepted; a route audited after the deadline is diagnostic only
fallback: frozen shared greedy (nearest pending, then base); computed before the core and never relabelled as a core result

stop_rules.per_call: soft deadline and the subprocess hard cap
stop_rules.round: stop at 75 full calls, 56 strip items or 8 GTSP items
